GA exam guide: 50 scored + 15 unscored, scaled 100–1000, pass 720. Confirm status, format, domains, task statements and in-scope services against the official exam page and the MLA-C02 exam guide on docs.aws.amazon.com (including its domain subpages and the MLA-C01 vs MLA-C02 comparison page). Use current names: Amazon SageMaker AI (Studio, Pipelines, Feature Store, Model Monitor, Clarify, JumpStart, Model Registry, HyperPod), Amazon Bedrock (Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, AgentCore, model customisation, evaluation). Never copy official sample questions.
name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
audience: ML engineers, data scientists and developers with a year of SageMaker AI and Bedrock experience
format: 65 items (50 scored, 15 unscored); multiple choice and multiple response; scaled score 100–1000, pass 720. The beta (from 29 Sep 2026) has 85 items in 170 minutes for $75.
scenarios: Document Q&A with a fine-tuned foundation model

domains.name: Data Preparation for ML and AI
skills: Ingest and store data (S3, formats like Parquet/CSV/JSON/RecordIO, streaming with Kinesis, Glue, EMR)
Transform and engineer features (Data Wrangler, Glue DataBrew, Feature Store, encoding, scaling, imputation)
Ensure data integrity and prepare for modeling: bias detection with Clarify, labeling with Ground Truth, data quality, splitting, PII handling; prepare data for FM customisation and RAG

domains.name: ML Model and Foundation Model (FM) Development
skills: Choose a modeling approach: built-in algorithms, JumpStart, Bedrock FMs, custom containers
Train and refine models: hyperparameter tuning (AMT), distributed training, regularisation, fine-tuning and continued pre-training of FMs, model versioning in Model Registry
Analyse performance: metrics, confusion matrix, RMSE, AUC, Clarify explainability, Debugger, FM evaluation

domains.name: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows
skills: Choose deployment infrastructure: real-time, serverless, asynchronous, batch transform endpoints; multi-model and inference components; edge
Provision compute and auto scaling; containers; IaC with CloudFormation/CDK
CI/CD and orchestration with SageMaker Pipelines, CodePipeline, Step Functions, MWAA; build agentic workflows with Bedrock and AgentCore

domains.name: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions
skills: Monitor inference: Model Monitor (data and model quality, bias drift, feature attribution drift), A/B and shadow testing
Monitor and optimise infrastructure and cost: CloudWatch, X-Ray, observability for agents, instance right-sizing, Spot, Savings Plans
Secure AI/ML: IAM roles and policies, VPC and PrivateLink, KMS encryption, Guardrails, compliance and governance (Model Cards, lineage)
